create_ScoringFunction: create a ScoringFunction subclass that scores state-update pairs as floats for quality comparison
create_RankingFunction: create a RankingFunction subclass that ranks state-update pairs from best to worst by index
create_SelectingFunction: create a SelectingFunction subclass that selects the index of the best state-update pair
build_ranker_from_scorer: build a RankingFunction from a ScoringFunction by scoring all pairs and sorting by decreasing score
build_ranker_from_selector: build a RankingFunction from a SelectingFunction by repeatedly selecting and removing the best pair
